post_ship_review.verdict: 8 CONFIRMED + 3 NEEDS_NUANCE, all fixed (mirrored from ZH)
fix_summary: (#60, CONFIRMED) softmax denominator 'sum exp >= 1' only holds after max-subtraction numerical stabilization, not for the raw formula — §2.3 corrected.

(#61, CONFIRMED) S2.2/S6's outer-product order S=sum phi(k)v^T vs S5 DeltaNet's transposed convention S=...+vk^T (masked by every demo setting d_k=d_v) — added an explicit convention note at both first-definition points (S2.2 and S5.1); doc-only fix, no math rewritten.

(#62, CONFIRMED) 'SSM <=> 1-semiseparable matrix M' corrected to N-semiseparable (N = SSM state dim; rank<=1 '1-semiseparable' is the degenerate N=1 case) — fixed at TL;DR item 4, the S4.1 SSD callout, and Q13.

(#63, CONFIRMED) Mamba-1 vs Mamba-2 'algorithmically equivalent' narrowed: the genuine equivalence is the 3 eval-paths (scan/chunkwise/quadratic) of the SAME (Mamba-2-restricted) SSD layer, not Mamba-1 vs Mamba-2 as models — fixed at S4.2 and Q14.

(#64, CONFIRMED) S7.5 table 'training' cell corrected: Longformer/BigBird DO apply their sparse pattern during (continued) pretraining, not only fine-tuning — table cell shortened + footnote callout added.
(#65, CONFIRMED) S9.1: even one full-attention layer in a hybrid keeps asymptotic time complexity at O(L^2); hybrids cut the constant factor, not the complexity class.
(#66, NEEDS_NUANCE) RetNet's positional info supplemented with its complex rotation factor Theta_n=e^{i n theta} (xPos/RoPE-style), on top of the scalar decay gamma — noted at S2.4 and S10.
(#67, CONFIRMED) 'linear attention is a finite-dimensional approximation of softmax' narrowed to Performer-class only (ELU+1/RetNet use a different kernel, not a softmax approximation).

(#68, CONFIRMED) Appendix code comment's iff-claim for delta-rule == additive final state corrected to sufficient-not-necessary; fixed the inline comment and the matching read-the-numbers prose for [e]. This snippet lives only in this .md's illustrative code block, not in code/linear_sparse_attention.py (unchanged).
(#59, NEEDS_NUANCE) S6.2's chunkwise derivation silently uses the UNNORMALIZED recurrence while S2.2's boxed formula is normalized — added a bridging sentence flagging this.

(#69, NEEDS_NUANCE -> resolved by live verification) the References claim of 'no independent arXiv paper' for DeepSeek-V3.2/DSA is outdated: arXiv 2512.02556 (2025-12-02) is now the official V3.2 report and documents DSA — reference entry updated.
